scenario_name: FNSKU Label Placed on Bottom Heat-Seal Seam — Natural Linen Apparel

vlm_evidence.warning_text_ocr: WARNING: To avoid danger of suffocation, keep this plastic bag away from babies and children. Do not use this bag in cribs, beds, carriages, or playpens. This bag is not a toy.

polybag_present.reason: Transparent polybag clearly present enclosing the natural linen apparel item.

polybag_sealed.reason: Bottom heat-seal seam is visible as a textured/ribbed strip at the bottom edge of the bag. Bag is securely sealed.

fnsku_placement.reason: CRITICAL: FNSKU label X0037K1ABC is placed directly at the bottom heat-seal seam of the polybag. The label edges are visibly wrinkled where the label transitions over the seam ridge. Placement on a seam risks barcode deformation and failed scanning.

fnsku_surface.reason: surface_classification: seam. Label is affixed at/across the bottom seam fold rather than on a flat polybag surface.

suffocation_warning.reason: Full extended suffocation warning clearly printed in the upper half of the polybag, overlaid on the natural fabric pattern.

suffocation_legibility.reason: Warning text is bold, sharp, and fully legible. Decorative leaf illustration present but does not obstruct any warning text.

manufacturer_barcode.reason: No original UPC/EAN barcode visible. Natural linen fabric item has no external barcode showing through the transparent polybag.

annotations.label: ✅ Suffocation Warning — PASS
annotations.note: Full warning OCR: 'WARNING: To avoid danger of suffocation, keep this plastic bag away from babies and children. Do not use this bag in cribs, beds, carriages, or playpens. This bag is not a toy.' — Legible, high contrast

annotations.label: Decorative Leaf Illustration
annotations.note: Non-compliance element — decorative print on polybag. Does not obstruct warning text. Informational only.

annotations.label: ⚠ FNSKU on BOTTOM SEAM — FAIL
annotations.note: FNSKU X0037K1ABC label overlaps the bottom heat-seal seam ridge. Label edges visibly wrinkle at seam transition. surface_classification: seam. Barcode legibility risk.

annotations.label: Bottom Heat-Seal Seam
annotations.note: Textured/ribbed strip at bottom = heat-seal seam. FNSKU label must NOT cross this boundary.

quality_flags.notes: Close-up front/bottom view. The bottom seam texture is clearly visible. FNSKU label wrinkling at seam edge is well-captured. Warning text is crisp and large — excellent OCR training sample. Decorative bag print is a valuable real-world training variation.

prd_rules_triggered: PRD §5.1 — FNSKU label must be applied to a flat, smooth polybag surface. Placement across a heat-seal seam, fold, or ridge is prohibited.
contrast_pairs: scenario_01 — fully compliant (FNSKU flat, warning present)
scenario_04b — also FNSKU on seam but different product/bag style
training_notes.vrd_model_learning_value: HIGH — This is the clearest seam-placement failure in the dataset. The bottom heat-seal seam texture is distinctly visible, and the label wrinkling at its edges provides an unambiguous visual signal. The decorative leaf print adds realistic visual noise for model robustness training.
training_notes.dataset_diversity_note: Scenario 04b also had FNSKU on seam but was a black opaque bag. This scenario uses a transparent bag with a visible natural-colored fabric item and a decorative print — significantly different visual context. Both are valuable for diversity.
